title: Financial Sustainability
guidingQuestion: How do we fund public digital infrastructure without ads or extractive capital alone?
summary: Sustainable community funding models for public-interest Meta-Layer infrastructure beyond advertising and venture dependence.
humanIssue: Good public infrastructure has no funding
webProblem: Dependence on advertising and venture capital

hero.headline: Infrastructure that serves everyone needs a durable purse.
hero.text: Critical digital public goods often survive on grants, burnout, or ads. Financial sustainability explores community funding that matches the mission.

problemStory.title: Why this matters
problemStory.scenario: A trusted open tool loses its grant. Maintainers face a choice: shut down, sell out, or bolt on surveillance advertising that contradicts the project values.

webLimitations.title: Why today's Web struggles
webLimitations.text: Markets fund what can lock in users. Shared infrastructure that anyone can use struggles to capture returns, so it underfunds by design.

futureVision.title: Imagine instead
futureVision.text: Communities, institutions, and beneficiaries co-fund the rails they rely on, with transparent budgets and stewardship.

audiences.label: Maintainers
audiences.why: Keep projects alive without mission betrayal.

audiences.label: Funders
audiences.why: Support durable commons, not one-off demos.

audiences.label: Governments
audiences.why: Treat digital public goods as infrastructure.

audiences.label: Users
audiences.why: Contribute fairly to tools they depend on.
